name: check_task_status
description: Check the current status of a background child task that was previously started with new_task using is_background=true, or a peer task sharing your root task. Returns the task's status and, if it has completed/errored/cancelled, its result or error message. If the task is blocked waiting for clarification from you (it called ask_followup_question), the pending question is surfaced here so you can answer it via answer_subtask_question. Set include_activity to true to also see what the task is currently doing (last few tool calls or messages).

include_activity.description: When true, include the child's most recent tool calls and messages in the response so you can see what it is currently working on.

task_id.description: The task ID returned when the background task was started.
